heading: The Road to Emmaus Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Road to Emmaus Bible crossword: the two disciples, the stranger who expounded the scriptures, and the breaking of bread. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: Two of them are walking to a village threescore furlongs from Jerusalem, talking about everything that has happened, when a stranger joins them and asks what the conversation is. Their eyes are holden that they should not know him. The Road to Emmaus covers Luke 24.

The best part of the chapter is what the stranger does on the road — beginning at Moses and all the prophets, expounding in all the scriptures the things concerning himself. The closing verse is the moment at the table when they finally see who it is.

clues.text: Their eyes were holden that they should not do this
He expounded the scriptures beginning at him
They knew him in the breaking of it

verseText: And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight.
